brief:
The Biden administration has signaled that a post-Netanyahu government in Israel could reset U.S. policy, Mondoweiss reported. Washington hopes a new Israeli leadership would help rehabilitate the country's international image and recover American public backing that has eroded during the current government's tenure.

U.S. officials view a change in Israeli leadership as an opportunity to chart a different diplomatic course. The shift reflects growing concern in Washington over deepening rifts between Israel and the American public, particularly regarding the conduct of the Gaza conflict.
dek: Washington's hopes for a new partner who can rehabilitate Israel's image and regain the support of the American people.
title: Washington seeks partner to restore Israel's U.S. support after Netanyahu
